title: Laurel source register
scope_note: Locators and reported Git object identities, not a manifest of downloaded source bytes. Source repositories were read, not built or modified. The article and its own companion are separate artifacts.

version_distinction.qualification: The newer snapshot is attributed to the reports; it is not relabeled as the independently observed remote main.

sources.title: From Properties to Proof Obligations: A critical synthesis of the nine round-3 proposals
sources.inspection_scope: Main text read closely, including the common calculus, finite inference, observation adequacy, worked examples, Leant discussion, implementation/evaluation sections, and next-round questions. This is not an independent rerun of the report's experiments or a claim to have read all individual proposals.

sources.title: Nine Refinements: Property-Aware Typing in a Mathematician's Proof Language over Lean
sources.inspection_scope: Main text read closely, including the commitment matrix, checked-core discussion, assessment, corrected completeness distinctions, reconciliation, and fourth-round questions. Externally included appendices and experiment logs were not independently audited in full.

sources.title: Sharp Lipschitz regularity of the Fabius and Rvachev functions
sources.inspection_scope: Full file read: derivative bounds, Lipschitz estimates, leastness arguments, and endpoint majorants. No repository build was run.

sources.title: Frey integral-to-rational model and supporting arithmetic
sources.inspection_scope: Full supplied file range read, including exact coefficient casts and the final solution adapter. No FLT build or new axiom audit was run.

sources.title: Fermat's Last Theorem in Lean 4
sources.inspection_scope: Repository README read. Compilation, comparator, and independent-kernel outcomes are the repository's reports, not executions in this work.

sources.title: Leant README
sources.inspection_scope: Opening approximately 130 lines read, covering the synthesis REPL, examples, documentation map, and initial highlights.

sources.title: Leant :synth internals
sources.inspection_scope: Opening 190 lines read, including the documented pipeline overview, historical evidence qualifications, and semantic-origin/provider-binding discussion. The entire long document was not independently audited.

sources.title: Leant.Synth.Length.Contract
sources.inspection_scope: Full module read: passive assertions, provider-law roles, exact source identities, scalar and joint paired-output contract vocabulary.

sources.title: Lean Language Reference: The Type System
sources.inspection_scope: Official type-system documentation. Latest documentation identified itself as 4.34.0-rc2 when consulted; this moving URL is not an immutable version pin.

sources.title: Mathlib.Tactic.FunProp
sources.inspection_scope: Official generated documentation for compositional function-property automation and its search/discharger interface. Moving documentation URL.

sources.title: Lean Language Reference: The mvcgen tactic
sources.inspection_scope: Official documentation for verification-condition generation. Used as a host-capability baseline; not executed by this companion.

sources.title: Ghalayini and Krishnaswami: Explicit Refinement Types
sources.inspection_scope: Primary paper metadata and research account, including explicit-evidence refinements; DOI 10.1145/3607837. Not a claim that Laurel implements this paper.

sources.title: Green, Karvounarakis, and Tannen: Provenance Semirings
sources.inspection_scope: Primary publication metadata for PODS 2007, pages 31-40. Attribution for algebraic provenance, not a source of the specific Laurel frontier algorithm.

sources.title: Provenance Semirings: author presentation
sources.inspection_scope: Primary author presentation; relevant provenance page inspected in a PDF screenshot. Used for alternative-versus-joint provenance.

sources.title: Carneiro: Lean4Lean: Verifying a Typechecker for Lean, in Lean
sources.inspection_scope: Primary paper, version 3 dated 14 September 2025. Used for the metatheory and checking burden of kernel changes, without claiming complete verification of all Lean features.
